extracted.summary: A solicitor enquires about a £14,000 litigation loan for a husband in divorce financial remedy proceedings, with around £151,500 of assets in dispute.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about funding for your client's financial remedy proceedings. We have noted the £14,000 requested and the approximately £151,500 of assets in dispute (property and pensions). To take this further we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction and court dealing with the matter, the current stage and any listed hearing dates, a breakdown of the costs to be funded, and details of the assets offered as security together with your client's identity and contact details. Our criteria and application form will follow from a member of the team, who will be in touch once we have reviewed the information provided.
